ازدهفتم (form VIII)
# اِزْدَهَفْتُمْ (izdahaftum) /iz.da.haf.tum/: second-person masculine plural past active of اِزْدَهَفَ (izdahafa)
# اُزْدُهِفْتُمْ (uzduhiftum) /uz.du.hif.tum/: second-person masculine plural past passive of اِزْدَهَفَ (izdahafa)
